verse.verse_1: When the earth quakes with its Zilzal.
verse.verse_2: And when the earth throws out its burdens.
verse.verse_3: And man will say: "What is the matter with it"
verse.verse_4: That Day it will declare its information.
verse.verse_5: Because your Lord will inspire it.
verse.verse_6: That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.
verse.verse_7: So, whosoever does good equal to the weight of a speck of dust shall see it.
verse.verse_8: And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of a speck of dust shall see it.
